question: Look up CAPEC-70 (Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords) — abstraction and status.

anchor_names.name: Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords
anchor_names.description: An adversary may try certain common or default usernames and passwords to gain access into the system and perform unauthorized actions. An adversary may try an intelligent brute force using empty passwords, known vendor default credentials, as well as a dictionary of common usernames and passwords.
anchor_names.label: AttackPattern

question: Which CWE weaknesses does CAPEC-555 exploit?

anchor_names.name: Remote Services with Stolen Credentials
anchor_names.description: This pattern of attack involves an adversary that uses stolen credentials to leverage remote services such as RDP, telnet, SSH, and VNC to log into a system. Once access is gained, any number of malicious activities could be performed.
anchor_names.label: AttackPattern
